i.norm: Verifies that flags retain the CREATE_TIME_BIT value (4) after parsing a buffer where the flags byte is at offset 1 but there is insufficient remaining data (only 1 byte available at that offset) to actually read the create timestamp. The flags field preserves the raw parsed byte even when the timestamp itself cannot be populated.

Build a 2-byte buffer: index 0 is unused padding, index 1 holds the flags byte. Setting the flags byte to CREATE_TIME_BIT (4) signals that a create timestamp is present, but no 4-byte timestamp follows because the buffer is too short.

Parse starting at offset 1 (the flags byte) with a declared length of 4. Only 1 byte is actually available from offset 1, so no timestamp data can be read. The flags field still captures the raw byte value of 4.
